title: The Purdue Model — IT/OT Network Layers
description: A Mermaid diagram of the Purdue Enterprise Reference Architecture: seven stacked ICS/OT layers from the enterprise network down to the physical process, with the firewalled IT/OT DMZ and the IT-vs-OT CIA priority inversion.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: cybersecurity

learningObjectives: Identify the seven layers of the Purdue model from the enterprise network to the physical process.
Explain the IT/OT DMZ boundary and why the CIA priority order inverts between IT and OT.
prerequisites: The CIA triad; basic networking and the idea of a DMZ

instructionalStrategies: Read the stack top-down, hovering each layer; stop at the DMZ to discuss the firewalled boundary.
Contrast the IT and OT CIA priority orders using the legend table.

assessmentQuestions.question: Why does the IT/OT DMZ forbid direct sessions from the enterprise into control systems?
Why does availability outrank confidentiality on the plant floor when the opposite holds in enterprise IT?
